about: Shared cases for «Registrar operação» (app/lib/domain/registro) and the SQL. Inputs are invented; every "expected" was computed by the functions and views of the Phase 3 migrations (20261020000001..4 of fase-3/banco) on a throwaway cluster, so the TypeScript test (cases.test.ts) checks that both sides give the same answer. Instants are UTC. Amounts are Postgres text.
